You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system and the exact names your specification must define so that it binds to a fixed model-checking configuration. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior and defines exactly the named constants, variables, and operators listed below. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models Conway's Game of Life on an N by N finite grid. The state consists of a single variable grid mapping each position in the set of board coordinates to a Boolean value indicating whether the cell is alive or dead, and the next-state relation computes the standard Life update rule from neighbor counts. The spec defines helper operators for summing values over a finite set, handling boundary cells outside the board as dead, and counting live neighbors; it verifies behavior through an initial condition and a temporal specification of repeated Next steps with stuttering allowed. There is no fault model, fairness condition, proof structure, or PlusCal algorithm in this file.

Your module MUST define these names so the configuration binds: N, TypeOK, Spec
